component.name: Retrovibe Console
component.summary: A versatile application for data archival and media playback

description.p: Retrovibed is a cooperative media platform for archiving and playing back your media collection. Ditch the algorithms, own your archive, and support creators directly.

ul.li: 4K video and lossless audio playback powered by ffmpeg
Built-in torrent client for peer-to-peer media distribution
Cloud archive with end-to-end encryption and zero-knowledge storage
Community-powered: artists receive the majority of subscription revenue
